---
name: WorkoutAtlas Documentation
description: "Use for Markdown, documentation consolidation, changelog, QA evidence, architecture, and knowledge-base maintenance."
applyTo: ["**/*.md", ".github/**/*.md", ".gitlab/**/*.md"]
---

- Update canonical documents instead of creating duplicate reports.
- Preserve historical entries and compatibility entry points.
- Every source claim must have repository or live evidence; otherwise mark UNVERIFIED.
- Do not include secrets or unnecessary personal data.
- Validate relative links and review git diff.
